recursively_flatten_list: recursively flatten a nested list of arbitrary depth into a single flat iterable
run_command: run a shell command with arguments and redirect stdout to stderr for parsing
make_temp_dir: create a temporary directory that is automatically cleaned up after use as a context manager
read_fbcode_builder_config: read and execute an fbcode_builder config file and return its config object
steps_for_spec: traverse build dependencies in depth-first order and return all steps needed to build a spec
